post_execution_equal_error_diagnostic.role: descriptive diagnostic only; not a preregistered primary endpoint
post_execution_equal_error_diagnostic.method: For each case, inspect all route-valid configurations satisfying the unscaled storage gate and find the REF_PROD/ROSS pair minimizing max(E_ref,E_ross)/min(E_ref,E_ross), where E is the frozen four-metric head/theta normalized error.
post_execution_equal_error_diagnostic.interpretation: The threshold-matched N1/N1 population is not an observed equal-error population. Under the frozen production Reference policy, the discrete valid control surfaces almost never overlap at comparable observed error.

supported: The final 36-case P2E21 REF-HIGH authority can be used for all frozen E3 cases.
Both production solvers have a valid configuration meeting every preregistered A1/A2/A3 accuracy threshold in all 36 cases.
The final threshold-matched control selection is N=1 for both solvers in all 36 cases.
The three cases newly admitted by P2E21 also have complete paired control selections.
important_limit: A common pass/fail accuracy threshold is not equivalent to matching the actually observed errors.
Because A1/A2/A3 all collapse to N=1, timing those selections would answer a threshold-satisfaction cost question, not a strict equal-observed-error question.
not_supported: A claim of strict equal-error performance from the N1/N1 selected population.
Post-hoc replacement of the accuracy targets.
